title: Arrived cracked!!!
text: Arrived cracked!!!. Super cute item what a great idea! Except the was cracked all the way down the middle upon arrival. No padding :( so disappointed. Costs more to ship back than I paid for it.

product_metadata.title: Arta by Chef'n Tasto Small Ceramic Serving Bowl
features: Innovative serving bowl with 1 removable dipping pouch
Made of durable ceramic; dipping pouch made of stain-resistant silicone that's heat safe up to 650 degrees Fahrenheit
Bowls are dishwasher safe and pouch is top rack dishwasher safe
Available in a choice of sizes; small, medium, and large
description: Blending form and function, the tasto serving bowls include innovative accessories. This small serving bowl (as well as the tasto medium and tasto large) comes with a removable dipping pouch made of 650-degree fahrenheit (340-degree celsius) heat and stain resistant silicone - great for holding dips of all consistencies. Bowls are dishwasher safe and pouch is top rack dishwasher safe. Attractive and versatile white finish. By arta. Defeat bland - whether it's bland food or bland table accessories, arta reawakens the senses. Their modern look is created by award winning designers.
